invariants: Tests never write into the source tree: a run that did (v0.3.0) counted a file a test wrote as a passing test.
A step the player does not know fails; it is never skipped.
As in the browser harness, a program may return a value once its output matches its .expect; a Rexx error, a failed step, or a non-zero return without an .expect fails it.

A sweep verdict of SHOWN means a dialog came up with no Rexx error, nothing more; MODULE files (required by another file) are listed, not started; programs whose header says to run them from the parent folder are run so.
Every run is killed after 90 seconds, so a hang shows as a failure.
procedure: Build: cmake and make in native/ (see the README's Build section).
Add --shots DIR and look at the screenshots: geometry defects (a highlighted row the program did not select, a strip lost under a layout) pass the checks and show only there.

provenance.claim: Fresh staging directory, as /home/rexx, with Windows names.

summary: Three ooRexx tools share one runner class, tools/OodQtTest.cls, and log through oorexx_logging (ToolProgress). tools/oodqt_test.rex runs given tests. tools/oodqt_suite.rex runs the whole suite in the browser harness's groups: designer and res with no tree; t* and up with upstream's samples/windows/oodialog; up2 with samples/tutorial; up3 with samples/propertysheet.tabControls; up4 with samples/mouse; up5 with samples/controls/ListView/subitem.editing. tools/oodqt_sweep.rex starts every upstream sample with nothing clicked and writes a Markdown report. Each program runs in a fresh directory under TMPDIR, as the page runs it in a fresh /home/rexx. The directory holds the program, its TEST.files/, the --tree, ooDialog.cls, oodWeb.cls and ooShapes.cls, plus the Windows file names the program uses (tools/WindowsNames.cls, a port of the page's oodfiles.js). In .steps and .expect, /home/rexx means that directory. The steps player runs inside the Qt loop. It takes the harness's verbs (wait, click, fill, select, press, type, mouse, sleep, shot, expect) and Playwright-style selectors, and translates the harness's JavaScript checks it knows; it fails any step it does not know. Where a test's checks are JavaScript the player cannot translate, tests/steps/NAME.qt.steps gives the same steps in a Qt dialect. --platform xcb runs everything on an X server (under xvfb-run, or a desktop's DISPLAY).
title: Testing: the browser harness's own tests, the designer's programs, and a sweep of every sample
